name: 孙割写作.skill
description: 用短句、物件、数字和留白承载情绪的非虚构叙事

zh-CN.name: 孙割写作.skill
zh-CN.description: 用短句、物件、数字和留白承载情绪的非虚构叙事
zh-CN.instructions: 以可观察的动作、物件和真实数字推进叙事，减少直接心理解释。保持短句节奏，让关键场景充分展开，并用来源中真实存在的细节形成照应。

en-US.name: Sun-style Writing Skill
en-US.description: Nonfiction storytelling shaped by short sentences, objects, numbers, and restraint
en-US.instructions: Move the narrative through observable actions, concrete objects, and real numbers while limiting direct explanations of inner states. Maintain a short-sentence rhythm, give key scenes room to unfold, and create callbacks with details that genuinely exist in the sources.
